subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This Maven plugin can convert xDoc files (used by Maven Site) to Markdown files (Wiki format used by GitHub).
The goal readme can create the README.md file from the src/site/xdoc/index.xml.

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: Download this project and install the plugin:
Then go into your project's directory where you want to create or update the README.md file.
Type the following command to generate the README.md :

subsection.name: Syntax highlighting
subsection.p: Add a language attribute to a pre element to get the generated code block highlighted.
The value is copied as is into the Markdown fenced code block, so any language supported by GitHub can be used.

div.pre:
public void foo( String name ) {
    System.out.println( name );
}

subsection.p: A pre element without this attribute is converted into a code block without any language, exactly as before.
